title: Assistance Coordination Note: Installment Deferrals Granted at a Patient Payment Plan Re-age
content:
A patient with an open application also defers installments at a **Patient Payment Plan** re-age on the assistance-linked terms Riverbend publishes. A financial assistance application of the patient is open when one of the patient's financial assistance cases in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) stands in submitted or pending documents status, a submitted case being taken first. The screening is the household federal poverty level (FPL) percentage recorded on that application in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care).

**Rule.** When the household was screened at or below 200 percent of the federal poverty level, the patient defers the Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan's skip allowance of 3 installments; when it was screened above 200 and at or below 400 percent, the Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan's allowance of 2 installments. Each is less the skips already used on the plan, but never fewer than none, and applies only on tiers whose own skip allowance is smaller. The deferred installments move to the end of the schedule too, together with the installments the re-age counts; otherwise none are deferred.

| Tier | Tier's own skip allowance | Screened at or below 200% FPL | Above 200% and at or below 400% FPL | Above 400% FPL, not screened, or no open application |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | 0 | 3, less skips used | 2, less skips used | none |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | 0 | 3, less skips used | 2, less skips used | none |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | 1 | 3, less skips used | 2, less skips used | none |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | 1 | 3, less skips used | 2, less skips used | none |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | 2 | 3, less skips used | none | none |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | 3 | none | none | none |

**Hypothetical.** On a plan of a tier with a skip allowance of 1, where 1 skip has been used, a household screened at 180 percent FPL defers 3 less 1, so 2 installments; screened at 320 percent it defers 2 less 1, so 1.
